_about: NRTL parameters fitted inside the MHV1 mixing rule (PSRK form) of SRK and Peng-Robinson to the open high-pressure data of the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive, by validation/fit_mhv1_high_pressure.mjs (proposal 0018; the maintainer, 2026-11-06). tau_ij = a_ij + b_ij / T (b in K), G_ij = exp(-alpha tau_ij); i, j in the order given. Used only by SRK/PR + gE (MHV1), not by the activity models.
